ExpeditionProfile.title: ExpeditionProfile
ExpeditionProfile.description: Shared profile configuration (nickname and character avatar) for each of the 4 Tokyo expedition members.

memberId.description: Unique preset identifier of the expedition member.

nickname.description: Customized display nickname shared across all devices.

defaultNickname.description: Original default nickname of the member.

avatarId.description: Selected character avatar identifier (Disney Princess, Smurf, or Valorant agent).

avatarEmoji.description: Emoji badge associated with the selected character avatar.

profileImageUrl.description: Optional base64 data URL or HTTPS image URL for a custom uploaded profile photo.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile modification.

ConnectionTest.title: ConnectionTest
ConnectionTest.description: Read-only document used to verify Firestore connectivity on startup.

/profiles/{memberId}.description: Stores shared character avatars and nicknames for the 4 expedition members.
